opening.quote: Good morning, Tidewell Home, my name is Femke. How can I help today?
opening.comment: You gave your name and the company name in your first turn, which meets the opening standard.

verification.quote: Could I take your full name and the order number or postcode?
verification.comment: You asked for the caller's full name and order number before discussing the order, and the caller provided both, so verification was done correctly.

understanding.quote: So you've opened a dispute with your bank about this payment?
understanding.comment: You captured the issue (a bank dispute on a rug payment) and confirmed it without asking for information the caller had already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: They'll reply to you by email within 2 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The Payments team replying within 2 working days matches policy, and no other amounts or timelines were stated incorrectly.

process_compliance.quote: Bank disputes are handled by our Payments team, so I've passed your case to them with all the details.
process_compliance.comment: You correctly did not handle the chargeback yourself and passed it to the Payments team as required.

communication.quote: I'm sorry it got to that point, I can hear this has been a hassle.
communication.comment: You were polite and acknowledged the caller's frustration when he said he was not happy, which is what this criterion asks for.

closing.quote: Is there anything else I can help you with?
closing.comment: You confirmed the next steps (Payments reply within 2 working days) and asked if there was anything else before closing politely.
